Concealed Pendent · Standard & Quick Response

Concealed Pendent Fire Sprinklers

Concealed pendent fire sprinklers for ceiling installations, available in standard response and quick response versions. Both response types offer metric K80 and K115 options. Select the response type and K-factor, then specify the temperature and matched cover assembly.

Standard / Quick ResponseK80 / K115 metric · K5.6 / K8.0 USDN15 / ½ in · DN20 / ¾ in57–141°C OptionsOEM / ODM
Ask on WhatsAppView available models

Use the model references to identify repeat orders. Specify the matched cover assembly, connection and marking required.

Product presentation

Mechanism, cover and temperature samples.

Review the concealed sprinkler mechanism, cover plate assembly and real product samples with different glass-bulb temperature colors. The product markings remain visible for model identification.

DN20 / ¾ in · K8.0 / K115 · 68°C1 / 6

Technical overview

Standard & quick response options.

The standard response version uses a 5 mm glass bulb. The quick response version uses a 3 mm glass bulb. Both are available in DN15 and DN20 configurations.

Response comparison

Standard Response5 mm glass bulb. DN15: K80 metric / K5.6 US; DN20: K115 metric / K8.0 US.
Quick Response3 mm glass bulb. DN15: K80 metric / K5.6 US; DN20: K115 metric / K8.0 US.
Available temperatures57, 68, 79, 93 and 141°C for both response groups.
Cover plateFor the DN15 / K80 configuration, the 68°C sprinkler is paired with a 59°C cover plate; adjustment range: 12.7 mm. Order the sprinkler and cover as a matched assembly. Other temperatures and DN20 / K115 pairings require separate confirmation.
Engineering noteFinal selection, ceiling arrangement, spacing, pressure and installation must follow the approved system design and exact supplied model.
